title: Hot Creamy Peruvian Navy Beans Aji De Gallina
description: A mustardy, creamy, crowd-pleaser Peruvian dish featuring dried white navy beans, smoke-hot, and flexitarian-friendly, served in a dolsot-stone-bowl.
instructions: Soak the dried white navy beans in water overnight, then drain and set aside.
In a large pot, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic in a little bit of oil until softened.
Add the chopped aji amarillo peppers to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the soaked and drained navy beans, heavy cream, grated cheddar cheese, dijon mustard, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir well to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 20 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the mixture to the desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Ladle the hot creamy navy beans into dolsot-stone-bowls and serve immediately.
